c74object.name: evi_resbank
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_resbank.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_resbank.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_resbank.genexpr file also requires:
evi_utilities.genexpr
About this File:
Three different resonant-like filters for filterbank style setups, originally created for the evieve vocoder.

entry.name: adSc1 ( )
entry.description:
First order antiderivative of a tanh()-like function
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
Return 1: tanh(), Antialiased audio output

entry.name: svfButterCoeffs ( )
entry.description:
Resonance coefficients calculator for the 'svfButterPreWarp()'
In 1: type=input: R, resonance inverted
Return 1: R1, Coefficient 1
Return 2: R2, Coefficient 2
Return 3: R3, Coefficient 3
Return 4: R4, Coefficient 4

entry.name: svfButterPreWarp ( )
entry.description:
Coefficients calculator for the 'svfButterBp()'
In 1: type=input: cutoff, in Hz
In 2: type=input: resonance, Normalised 0..1
Return 1: w0, Normalised frequency coefficient
Return 2: pksR, Normalised resonance coefficient as factor of resonance and frequency
Return 3: R1, Resonance coefficient 1
Return 4: R2, Resonance coefficient 2
Return 5: R3, Resonance coefficient 3
Return 6: R4, Resonance coefficient 4

entry.name: svfCoeffReson ( )
entry.description:
Coefficients calculator for the 'svfSectionReson()'
In 1: type=input: hz, Cutoff in Hz
In 2: type=input: q, Resonance 0.05..10000
Return 1: a0, Filter coefficient 1
Return 2: a1, Filter coefficient 2
Return 3: a2, Filter coefficient 3
Return 4: k, Gain coefficient

entry.name: svfButterBp ( )
entry.description:
Transposed TPT SVF
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: w, Frequency coefficient
In 3: type=input: k, Gain coefficient
Return 1: Bandpass, TPT Bandpass filter

entry.name: svfSectionReson ( )
entry.description:
Linear Trapezoidal SVF
In 1: type=input: v0, Audio input
In 2: type=input: a0, Filter coefficient 1
In 3: type=input: a1, Filter coefficient 2
In 4: type=input: a2, Filter coefficient 3
Return 1: Bandpass, LTO Bandpass filter

entry.name: onepole4 ( )
entry.description:
It is a shocking bastardisation of an evieve transistor ladder (@see: 'evi_ladder_moog.gendsp')
In 1: type=input: x, Audio input
In 2: type=input: w, Frequency coefficient
In 3: type=input: k, Gain coefficient
Return 1: LP_24dB, Lowpass output, 24dB
Return 2: LP_12dB, Lowpass output, 12dB
Return 3: BP_18dB, Bandpass output, 18dB
Return 4: HP_24dB, Highpass output, 24dB
